title: ICC rejects defense’s motion to have prosecution open a new case file

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Tuesday denied former President Rodrigo Duterte’s defense team’s motion to have the prosecution open a completely new case file with a new evidence list limited to about 10,000 documents.
